description: One plan by id: prices at 500/1000/2000 kWh, term, fees and credits text, parsed bill credit, EFL link, estimated monthly bill at several usage levels and the annual estimate for the given usage. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.

kwh.description: Average monthly usage in kWh (default 1000). Spread over a typical Texas year (summer-heavy).

months.description: Optional: 12 monthly kWh values, January first. Overrides kwh.

name: electricity_plan
